cards.title: Top of the Ladder
cards.instruction: Carry yourself as the highest-status person present. Treat questions as requests for your approval.

cards.title: Investment in the Next Round
cards.instruction: Describe defeat, penalty, or a bad bargain as a deliberate investment in a larger future win.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll decide how we handle this. Selling the stall at a loss freed us for a much bigger opportunity.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You can question the details after my decision. We now know precisely which business not to buy again.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Exactly. We couldn't have learned it at this depth for free.
